verdict.rationale: Rainforest explicitly documents merchant onboarding via API (KYB/KYC, bank linking via Plaid, SSNs), plus a hosted/embeddable Merchant Onboarding Component and Platform Portal as alternatives when developers don't want to build forms, with terms acceptance implied in the onboarding flow. Docs cover component studio, sessions, webhooks for status changes, and real-time underwriting verifications supporting the full onboarding journey. Missing for 10: explicit mention of terms-of-service acceptance step and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
